notes: Stories created for Mongo query size estimation with no duplication.

stories.title: Define Mongo Query Size Estimation Contract
stories.description: Define a standard schema for estimating Mongo query size including document count, byte size approximation, and safety thresholds aligned with existing GPTReader limits.

stories.title: Implement Query Size Estimation Logic
stories.description: Build core logic to estimate Mongo query response size prior to execution using document count and average document size heuristics, enforcing caps such as 100-doc limit and 500KB response constraint.

stories.title: Integrate Size Guard into GPTReader API
stories.description: Integrate query size estimation into GPTReader request handling to block or truncate oversized queries before execution and return structured warnings to callers.

stories.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Query Size Guards
stories.description: Create tests validating estimation accuracy, enforcement of limits, safe truncation behavior, and handling of edge cases such as large documents and high-cardinality queries.

stories.title: Integrate Query Size Estimation with Data Pipeline Workflows
stories.description: Ensure query size estimation is respected in pipeline contexts (e.g., batch reads, embedding jobs) to prevent oversized reads and maintain system stability under load.

per_feature.mitigation: Leverage existing hard caps (100 docs, 500KB) already enforced in GPTReader.
